name: @waste/api
description: The Hono API: the only web boundary to domain data (ADR-0001). Slice 6 of Issue #45 is the scaffold: GET /healthz, GET /openapi.json (OpenAPI 3.1 through hono-openapi) and an environment parsed once at startup. No database, no auth yet. Runs TypeScript source through tsx, like every workspace package, until hosting decides on bundling.
